context: Chapter upload validation uses complete translated messages with named chapter/count/time placeholders; first timestamp0:00 is preserved. Provider chapter timing rules remain distinct from manually authored minimum spacing.

A video can have up to {count} chapters..en: A video can have up to {count} chapters.
A video can have up to {count} chapters..de: Ein Video kann bis zu {count} Kapitel haben.

Chapter {number} has an invalid timestam.de: Die Zeitangabe für Kapitel {number} ist ungültig.

The first chapter must start at 0:00..en: The first chapter must start at 0:00.
The first chapter must start at 0:00..de: Das erste Kapitel muss bei 0:00 beginnen.

Chapter timestamps must be in order and.en: Chapter timestamps must be in order and at least {seconds} seconds apart.
Chapter timestamps must be in order and.de: Die Kapitelzeiten müssen aufsteigend sein und mindestens {seconds} Sekunden auseinanderliegen.

Chapter {number} starts after the video.en: Chapter {number} must start before the video ends.
Chapter {number} starts after the video.de: Kapitel {number} muss vor dem Ende des Videos beginnen.

Add a name for chapter {number} or turn.en: Add a name for chapter {number} or turn off Upload with chapters.
Add a name for chapter {number} or turn.de: Gib Kapitel {number} einen Namen oder deaktiviere „Mit Kapiteln hochladen“.

The name for chapter {number} must be 16.en: The name for chapter {number} must be 160 characters or fewer.
The name for chapter {number} must be 16.de: Der Name für Kapitel {number} darf höchstens 160 Zeichen lang sein.
